ऋ The seventh vowel of the San-
scrit alphabet, as
r in
merry.

ऋ (आ) 4.
f. A name of Aditī mo-
ther of the gods. An interjection
of abuse, laughter, &c.

ऋ ऋच्छति 1.
a. To go; to gain.
(लि, र) ईयर्त्ति 3.
a. To go. (न, र)
ऋणोति 5.
a. To injure, to kill.

ॠ The long vowel corresponding
to the short one preceding.

ॠ (री) 4.
f. The mother of the
gods; also of the demons; re-
collection.
m. Shiva, a demon.
(आ) 4.
m. The breast; motion.
Interj. alas! A magic letter.
